notes.title: CRYSTAR New Prices in US and select regions, Soundtrack, and Bundle Now on Sale!
notes.content:
New content for CRYSTAR has been released. The complete soundtrack for the main game is now available on Steam. As well as a bundle that includes the main game and the soundtrack. Save 30% off the both products. Users who already own the main game are also able to purchase the soundtrack via the bundle to take advantage of the discount. 

The main game is also now available at a new price of $19.99 and approximate equivalent for select regions. Regions that did not receive a new price are due to receive one at a later date.

Check the new products out via the links below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320120

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47463

notes.title: CRYSTAR Holiday Collection DLC Available Today!
notes.content:
The Holiday Collection of Santa costume DLC for CRYSTAR are available now! The costumes provide in-game bonuses so you can fight through Purgatory in style.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32618574/f99558cbdb9cb421f5dfd139e1ca6bd8f5aa98b5.png[/img]
[b]Holiday Collection DLC[/b]
Get in the holiday spirit with the CRYSTAR Holiday Collection DLC!

If you have a character in your party wearing one of these costumes, Revenants with uncollected memoirs will be drawn to you. Don these costumes to collect all the Memoirs of the Dead. 
*The feature only works on levels where Revenants with memoirs appear. 

[b]Holiday Collection DLC Bundle[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12599

notes.content:
[b][PATCH NOTES][/b]

[*]Diary text can now be scrolled using mouse wheel.
[*]Updated Help menu UI for keyboard controls[/list]

notes.title: PEDDLER COLLECTION DLC AND MASCOT COSTUME COLLECTION DLC AVAILABLE TODAY
notes.content:
New CRYSTAR costume DLCs, the Peddler Collection DLC and the Mascot Costume Collection DLC are available now! The costumes provide in-game bonuses so you can fight through Purgatory in style.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32618574/25c4041f5798ac88bf71f1662522bfe5216937f8.png[/img]
[b]Peddler Collection DLC[/b]
Talk to the Peddler while wearing this fashionable costume and any items you purchase from her in Purgatory come with a 10% discount!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32618574/67552ea2a3f35d1c4a0038d32a88cc9bb01e916c.png[/img]
[b]Mascot Costume Collection DLC[/b]
Dress up as an animal mascot that represents each character: 
Rei: Thelema, her dog
Kokoro: Wolf
Sen: Lion 
Nanana: Bird 
If you have a character in your party wearing one of these costumes, Revenants with uncollected memoirs will be drawn to you. Don these costumes to collect all the Memoirs of the Dead. 
*The feature only works on levels where Revenants with memoirs appear. 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11908]Peddler Collection DLC Set[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11909]Mascot Costume Collection DLC Bundle[/url][/b]
